description: Toll Calculator API is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. The Toll Calculator API has been updated to Version 2 as of 16 June 2020 and provides developers a means of accessing the most up-to-date toll pricing for journeys undertaken across NSW roads. Disclaimer: The results returned by the Toll Calculator API are estimates only. Coverage: Transport for NSW. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
